description: Mark that the worker is on the way to a visit, with an optional ETA (eta_at, or eta_minutes from now). The worker on the visit (or the office) can do this. When the shop has on-my-way notices on, the customer gets one email saying who is coming and when.
name: visits_onTheWay

customer_notice.description: Whether an on-my-way email to the customer was queued. It is sent only if the customer has an email address.
